title: Animal Character Design
description: Rough character sketches of otters, prairie dogs, and sea lions, pushing expression and pose to see how much personality each animal could carry.
content: Rough sketches working out animal characters — otters, prairie dogs, sea lions. I was pushing expressions and poses to see how much personality I could get out of each animal: surprise, anger, frustration, the works. Loose linework, exploratory, nothing finalized.
